comment: Fixed persona for the COACH CHAT tone measurement. KEEP THIS FILE STABLE so before/after runs stay comparable — same rule as warmth-measure.json. The context block is a fixed snapshot in the same shape ChatAssistant's buildContext sends; nothing here touches a database.
